reason: I've never heard of Nora Furnish and nothing here tells me the fixture is UL listed, what the lumens are, or how it mounts, which my electrician needs before he'll hang it. I'm not putting $360 on a store I can't vet when I've already walked out of a showroom this weekend.
objection: Is it UL listed and safe, and will my electrician install it? There are no lumens, wattage, canopy or wiring details, and I pay return shipping if I change my mind on a fixture that might not fit the room.
would_change_my_mind: A UL/ETL listing shown on the product page, a full spec sheet (lumens, wattage, dimmability, canopy size, wiring and install instructions), and independent reviews or photos from real buyers, plus free returns.
